symptom: The selection-popup Escape regression test tried to reselect the same text by dragging inside the existing HTML selection; Chromium treated it as a text drag, left an empty selection, and made main red without a product failure.
rule: Browser selection regression tests must distinguish a new selection gesture from dragging the existing HTML selection; when asserting dismissal until the selection changes, select different text. See zstack-eval's test-only-fix seeding rule.
